name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
about: Bajaj Finance is mainly engaged in the business of lending. BFL has a diversified lending portfolio across retail, SME and commercial customers with a significant presence in urban and rural India. It also accepts public and corporate deposits and offers variety of financial services products to its customers.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:124)

cash.note: For lenders, operating cash flow mostly reflects loan-book growth, so conversion ratios are not meaningful.

flags.text: Share capital up 402% in three years: new shares from an issue, a merger or a bonus. Only the first two dilute

business.what: Bajaj Finance is a non-bank lender offering consumer, rural, MFI, gold, MSME, vehicle and loan-against-securities loans. It earns from lending, funded by borrowings and deposits, and reports net interest income (NTI).

segments.name: Urban consumer finance
segments.comment: AUM grew 43% in the quarter, a strong contributor to overall growth.

segments.name: Rural consumer finance
segments.comment: AUM grew 63%, the fastest-growing consumer line this quarter.

segments.name: MFI (microfinance)
segments.comment: Grew 54% on a low base, with branches still being added.

segments.name: CV and tractor finance
segments.comment: Grew 89% on a low base, per management.

segments.name: Gold loans
segments.comment: Book just above INR 24,000 crore; Stage 2 rose on short-tenor schemes, now stopped.

segments.name: MSME
segments.comment: Grew only 3%; management expects double-digit growth in the second half.

segments.name: Captive book (wind-down)
segments.comment: Running down to about INR 2,400 crore, easing future credit costs.

kpis.name: Customer franchise
kpis.value: Just under 129 million customers; 4.42 million added in quarter

ledger.promise: FY27 AUM growth of 20%-24% (also stated as 22%-24% on the same call)
ledger.quote: we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth, aided by new businesses that we've launched in the last few years
ledger.actual: Raised to 26%-27% on the Q2 FY27 call. AUM not in the data. Borrowings rose 15.4% from 435,112 (FY26) to 501,982 (latest).

ledger.promise: FY27 credit cost of 145-160 bps, trending down from 1.65%
ledger.quote: some level of conservatism in terms of doing the number crunching and giving a guidance of 145 to 160 has been done.
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 call: 'one of the lowest years on credit costs… well on track', but an overlay was added on top of ECL. No credit cost figure in the data.

ledger.promise: Only marginal moderation in FY27 NIM
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 put a number on it: 10-15 bps. Q2 FY27 added 'a marginal headwind to that number' because of repo rate hikes in Q3-Q4.

ledger.promise: Opex to NTI improves 25-40 bps in FY27
ledger.quote: On opex to NTI, we expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels.
ledger.actual: Reaffirmed on the Q1 and Q2 FY27 calls. No ratio is given. EBITDA margin was 36.0% in Q2 FY27 against 34.3% in Q2 FY26.

ledger.quote: We continue to guide for 4.4% to 4.6%.
ledger.actual: The data has no asset base and later calls give no ROA figure.

ledger.promise: FY27 ROE of 19%-20% (the same call also said 20%-22%)
ledger.quote: we continue to guide for 19% to 20%.
ledger.actual: The data has no equity figures. The Q1 FY27 call only said ROE would improve in Q2 after the dividend; no figure is given.

ledger.promise: Profit growth higher than balance sheet growth
ledger.quote: the profit growth principally should be higher than balance sheet growth.
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 PAT 12,448 vs 9,713, up 28.2%, slightly above the 26-27% AUM guidance. In FY26, PAT grew 15.2% while borrowings grew 20.4%.

ledger.promise: MSME back to double-digit growth between Q2 and Q3 FY27
ledger.quote: We expect that it should come back to double -digit growth or the company growth momentum between Q2 and Q3 of FY'27.
ledger.actual: The wording moved from 'between Q2 and Q3' to 'by Q3 or so' (Q1) and then 'second half' (Q2). No MSME growth figure has been reported.

ledger.promise: Worst of the credit cycle behind by June 2026
ledger.quote: And I think in our assessment, the worst is behind us by June '26.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27: Stage 2+3 at 1.87%, expected to keep improving. Q2 FY27 credit costs are said to be among the lowest, but gold Stage 2 rose 1,047 crore, an overlay was added and some districts are stressed.

ledger.promise: Captive 2W/3W book below 1,500 crore by September 2026
ledger.quote: This book will principally just wind down to less than INR 1,500- odd crores by September '26
ledger.actual: The Q2 FY27 call materials do not report the size of this book.

ledger.promise: Add 15-17 million new customers in FY27
ledger.quote: we continue to be confident of adding 15 - 17 million new customers in FY27.
ledger.actual: Raised to 18-20 million on the Q2 FY27 call. No year-to-date count is given.

ledger.promise: Gold loans above roughly 5% of AUM by FY27
ledger.quote: We foresee gold loan portfolio to probably cross 5 -odd percent of total AUM by FY'27.
ledger.actual: No share figure has been reported. Q2 FY27: gold Stage 2 rose 1,047 crore from short-tenure schemes, which were stopped in August.

current_guidance.quote: I would say probably between 26%, 27% growth we should deliver now on a full year basis.

current_guidance.target: 10-15 bps compression plus a marginal additional headwind
current_guidance.quote: I had given a guidance of 10 to 15 basis point compression in the current year. I would say carry a marginal headwind to that number
We remain pretty comfortable place to deliver a 25 to 40 basis point improvement in FY27 on opex-to-NTI.

current_guidance.target: One of the lowest years on credit costs (the 145-160 bps range was not restated)
current_guidance.quote: this is likely to be one of the lowest years on credit costs. We are well on track for that.
We are clear about adding between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27.
We are well on track to deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.

current_guidance.target: 20%-25% (p12) or 23%-25% (p15), two different ranges on the same call
current_guidance.quote: I'm not changing, I must say to you, the longer -term growth guidance of 23% to 25%.
get to as per last as I say INR11 lakh crores number by FY30.
we should be able to sustain a 15% to 18% fee income growth is what I would just say to you

current_guidance.target: About 180 agentic applications and about 600 agents
current_guidance.quote: We are well on track to deliver 180-odd agentic applications and 600-odd agents for the year.

current_guidance.target: 800 crore/month at FY27 exit; 1,300-1,400 crore/month by Q3 FY28
current_guidance.quote: I think exiting the year, they would be at INR800 crores a month, and should continue to probably get to INR1,300 crores, INR1,400 crores a month sometime by third quarter of next year.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Halfway through FY27, management has raised its AUM and customer targets and PAT is up 28.2% year on year. Over the same period it has cut NIM guidance twice and let the MSME recovery date slip from 'Q2-Q3' to 'second half'. The record is harder to judge because the April 2026 call gave conflicting ranges (AUM 20-24% vs 22-24%, ROE 19-20% vs 20-22%), and key metrics (ROA, ROE, credit cost, the run-off book size) cannot be checked against the data provided.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Profit growth should run ahead of balance sheet growth
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 PAT +15.2% (19,332 vs 16,779) against borrowings +20.4% (435,112 vs 361,249). H1 FY27 PAT +28.2% against FY27 AUM guidance of 26-27%.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: AUM growth raised to 26-27% for FY27
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Revenue grew only 18.6% y/y in Q1 FY27 and 22.8% in Q2 FY27 (H1 +20.7%). Borrowings rose 15.4% from the FY26 level to 501,982. Revenue is growing slower than the raised AUM target, which fits the NIM compression guidance.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: NIM under pressure from rising repo rates and higher borrowing costs
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Reported EBITDA margin rose from 35.4% in Q4 FY26 to 36.4% in Q1 FY27 and was 36.0% in Q2 FY27, against 34.3% in Q2 FY26. The headline numbers do not yet show the margin squeeze management describes.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Worst of the credit cycle behind by June 2026; FY27 among the lowest credit cost years
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: PAT growth in Q2 FY27 was 4.7% quarter on quarter (6,367 vs 6,081) with no provision shock. The same call disclosed an ECL overlay, a 1,047 crore rise in gold Stage 2 and district-level stress. The FY26 dip remains in the record: Q3 FY26 PAT 4,066, down 17.8% q/q, margin 28.3%.

bull.evidence: Q2 FY27 PAT 6,367 vs 4,948 (+28.7% y/y). H1 FY27 PAT 12,448 vs 9,713 (+28.2%), compared with FY26 full-year PAT growth of 15.2%.
FY27 AUM guidance moved from 20-24% to 26-27%. New customer target moved from 15-17 million to 18-20 million.

bull.point: Cost efficiency guidance held each quarter and margins are higher
bull.evidence: The 25-40 bps opex-to-NTI improvement was restated on the Q1 and Q2 FY27 calls. EBITDA margin was 36.0-36.4% in H1 FY27 against 33.9-34.3% in H1 FY26.
bull.source: Q2 FY27 call p4; reported numbers

bear.evidence: It went from 'marginal moderation' (Apr) to 10-15 bps (Aug) to 10-15 bps 'plus a marginal headwind' (Oct), with repo hikes feeding into Q3-Q4 and borrowing costs carrying an 'upward bias'.
bear.source: Q2 FY27 call p13; Q1 FY27 call p12, p14

bear.point: Asset quality signals conflict with the 'lowest credit cost year' claim
bear.evidence: Gold Stage 2 rose 1,047 crore from short-tenure schemes. An overlay was added because ECL 'fails to capture' real-world effects, and some districts are more affected than expected. The FY27 outlook was conditional on geopolitical tensions easing.
bear.source: Q2 FY27 call p4, p10, p20; Q4 FY26 call p6

bear.point: Guidance is inconsistent and partly cannot be checked
bear.evidence: Conflicting ranges were given on the same call: AUM 20-24% vs 22-24% and ROE 19-20% vs 20-22% (Apr), and long-term AUM 20-25% vs 23-25% (Oct). ROA, ROE and the run-off book size cannot be verified from the data.
bear.source: Q4 FY26 call p6, p7, p9, p17; Q2 FY27 call p12, p15
